scripts.translation: 哦？这主意倒不错，正好可以好好谈谈。不过我还得整理刚带来的东西，怎么办呢？

scripts.text: Ah, of course! Adventurer! Would you care to go? Explore this place, take in the sights, and perhaps make a lasting impression on the locals as well.
scripts.translation: 啊，对了！冒险者，要不要去看看？四处探索、欣赏风景，也给村民们留下个好印象。

scripts.text: Since we'll be staying here for a while anyway, right? Everyone here is as friendly and kind-hearted as I am, so you won't encounter any hostility.
scripts.translation: 反正我们会在这里住一阵子，对吧？这里的人都和我一样热情友善，你不会碰壁的。

scripts.text: Just go and check whether what Aisha brought back is a real wolf cub or just a puppy that looks like a wolf.
scripts.translation: 去确认一下艾莎带回来的究竟是狼崽，还是长得像狼的小狗。

scripts.text: Oh... well, I haven't really thought that far. But wouldn't it be troublesome if it's really a wolf cub? Even a puppy would be a hassle in that case.
scripts.translation: 哦......我还没想那么远。不过要真是狼崽，确实会很麻烦吧？即使只是小狗，也挺让人为难的。

scripts.text: Let me explain for our newly arrived adventurer. Here, the land is such that there aren't many animals suitable for raising.
scripts.translation: 我先给刚来的冒险者解释一下。这里的环境不适合饲养很多种动物。

scripts.text: Mostly, Skania takes care of the sheep and chickens. There are hardly any cattle or pigs that can adapt to such places. Therefore, livestock is really precious here.
scripts.translation: 平时主要由斯堪尼亚照看羊和鸡。这里几乎养不了适应环境的牛或猪，所以牲畜非常珍贵。

scripts.text: But what if what Aisha is carrying is indeed a wolf cub?
scripts.translation: 可要是艾莎带回来的是狼崽呢？

scripts.text: The mother is coming to find her cub!
scripts.translation: 狼妈妈会来找自己的孩子！

scripts.text: Even if the mother doesn't come looking for it?
The cub will grow up and start harming the livestock!
scripts.translation: 狼崽长大以后就会伤害牲畜！

scripts.text: Where did Aisha live again? Ah, right! <NAVI>[Upper Side]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, if you go there, you'll find Aisha's house.
scripts.translation: 艾莎住在哪儿来着？啊，对了！去<NAVI>[上方]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>就能找到她家。

scripts.text: But there's no point in saying it, right? If I persuade you, it might change your mind about me too.
scripts.translation: 反正说了也没用吧？我要是劝你，说不定你对我的看法也会变。

scripts.text: Adventurer, then, please go and return safely! I'll take my leave for now too!
scripts.translation: 冒险者，那就拜托你了，一定要平安回来！我也先告辞了！

scripts.text: <NAVI>[Aisha]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, no matter how many times I say it to you, it won't make a difference, will it? If I persuade you, it might change my opinion of you too.
scripts.translation: <NAVI>[艾莎]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，不管我跟你说多少次都没用吧？我要是劝你，说不定我对你的看法也会改变。

scripts.text: <NAVI>[Aisha]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> for a hundred days won't help? If you convince me, I'll change my opinion of you.
scripts.translation: <NAVI>[艾莎]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，劝上一百天也没用吗？你要是说服了我，我就改变对你的看法。

scripts.text: Woof woof. Today's walk is over now. I'm too tired.
scripts.translation: 汪汪。今天散步就到这里吧，我累了。

scripts.text: I can't let you go alone. How can I send you to such a dangerous place alone? Of course, I know you can handle a walk by yourself, but I'm worried.
scripts.translation: 我不能让你一个人去啊！怎么能让你独自去那么危险的地方？我知道你自己能应付，但还是担心。

scripts.text: Aisha? Why are you here? Did you come to return the wolf?
scripts.translation: 艾莎？你怎么来了？是来送狼崽回去的吗？

scripts.text: No, it's not like that. You brought the wolf... with you? In front of the sheep? Are you out of your mind?
scripts.translation: 不对，不是那样。你把狼带来了？还带到羊群面前？你疯了吗？

scripts.text: Why on earth are you trying to raise a wolf? Do you need a dog? Then get a dog.
scripts.translation: 你干嘛非要养狼？想养狗的话就养狗啊。不如我来当

scripts.text: No, I'll just become the dog. I'll mess up your house too and occasionally bite you.
scripts.translation: 狗好了，我会把你家弄得乱七八糟，还会时不时咬你。

scripts.text: Scania, I heard your wishes loud and clear. So, did you even send a person to me? Are you treating me like some kind of a contractor, adventurer?
scripts.translation: 斯堪尼亚，你的话我都听见了。你甚至派人来找我？你把我当成什么委托人了吗，冒险者？

scripts.text: Despite all your efforts, so what? This person has already sided with me! Hahaha! Come on, show me that face of despair!
scripts.translation: 你费尽心思又怎么样？这位已经站在我这边了！哈哈哈！来，让我看看你绝望的表情！

scripts.text: What? Adventurer? You betrayed me? How could you do that? Betrayal at first sight, isn't that too much? I should have known. Outsiders like you can't be trusted.
scripts.translation: 什么？冒险者，你背叛我了？怎么能这样？刚见面就背叛，也太过分了吧！我早该知道，外人根本不可信。

scripts.text: Scania, have you ever been to the Ice Caves? Is the blood flowing in your veins colder than the frozen water there? You cold-blooded one!
scripts.translation: 斯堪尼亚，你去过冰洞吗？你血管里的血比那里的冰水还冷吗？你这个冷血的家伙！

scripts.text: How can you even suggest sending this small and fragile little creature back to such a dangerous place? Its mother is dead, and it can't survive on its own.
scripts.translation: 你怎么能把这么弱小的孩子送回那么危险的地方？它的母亲已经死了，它自己活不下去。

scripts.text: I said that, didn't I? I told you a hundred times. You didn't listen again, did you? You just believe what you want to believe, right?
scripts.translation: 我不是说过了吗？都告诉你一百遍了，你又没听吧？你只相信自己想相信的，对不对？

scripts.text: I don't know about you, but I can't bear to send this small and fragile young wolf back to the market.
scripts.translation: 你怎么想我不管，但我不忍心把这么弱小的幼狼送回去。

scripts.text: But if that wolf grows up, our sheep...
scripts.translation: 可是等狼长大了，我们的羊......

scripts.text: Oh, do I need to talk about it?
You won't listen to me anyway. You never listen to me when I talk, and you only believe what other people say.
scripts.translation: 反正你也不会听我的。我说的话你从来不听，只相信别人说的。

scripts.text: This wolf cub will be fine if it is trained. If it grows up with other friends from a young age, it will not harm them and will instead protect the sheep.
scripts.translation: 只要好好训练，这只狼崽就不会有事。从小和伙伴们一起长大的话，它不会伤害大家，反而会保护羊群。

scripts.text: Did you hear me? Where is your refutation? Come on, smart genius! Sit down! Hands up!
scripts.translation: 听见了吗？怎么不反驳？来啊，聪明的大天才！坐下！举手！

scripts.text: It's true. But... but I don't know how long it will last... I don't know if it will be able to suppress its wild nature...
scripts.translation: 你说得没错。可是......我不知道能坚持多久，也不知道它能不能压住野性......

scripts.text: But most of all, I don't think you'll be able to train it that patiently.

scripts.translation: 习惯了舒适，就会受不了艰苦的生活。只要在他们给的最低限度生活里知足就行。听说你

scripts.text: They say that if you protest, they will take this away too.
scripts.translation: 们一抗议，他们连这点东西也会收走。

scripts.text: How long do you think we're going to live here, never mind take our land back!
scripts.translation: 更别说夺回土地了，你觉得我们还要在这里住多久？

scripts.text: What you have now is enough, what more do you need?
scripts.translation: 你现在有的已经够多了，还想要什么？

scripts.text: I'm not doing this because I'm ungrateful. They say that they are not bringing it here because this it's too foreign for them. Technology and facilities have developed over time, but you just don't understand it!
scripts.translation: 我不是不知感恩。他们说这些东西对他们来说太陌生，所以不愿带到这里来。技术和设施一直在进步，可你就是不明白！

scripts.text: Oh my, I think I'm dying. Help...
scripts.translation: 哎呀，我好像快不行了。救命......

scripts.text: Maram? What is it? What happened?
scripts.translation: 玛拉姆？怎么了，发生什么事了？

scripts.text: If I die... put my accumulated wealth...! With me. Did you get it?! It's unfair! Maram, make sure you guard my grave well! Don't let a single penny be stolen!
scripts.translation: 我要是死了......就把我攒下的财富......都埋进坟墓里。听见没？！太不公平了！玛拉姆，好好守住我的坟墓！一分钱也别让人偷走！

scripts.text: No, you won't die. Don't be ominous.
scripts.translation: 不会死的，别说这种不吉利的话。

scripts.text: There's been an accident while moving the luggage. I need to get it taken care of quickly. Can you do that, Ezekiel?
scripts.translation: 搬运行李时出了事故，得赶紧处理。以西结，你能帮忙吗？

scripts.text: Oh my, how come? I can't use one leg at all and I'm still fine.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，怎么会这样？我一条腿都不能动了，不也还好好的吗？

scripts.text: Let's move it to my house quickly. I may not be able to use my legs, but I need to at least apply some medicine to prevent them from rotting.
scripts.translation: 快把他抬到我家去。我腿脚不方便，但至少能给他上点药，免得伤口恶化。

scripts.text: Do I have to cut my legs off like Mr. White Pine over here? I can't do that... I just bought a new pair of work boots...!
scripts.translation: 我也得像那边的白松先生一样把腿砍掉吗？我可做不到......我才买了双新工作靴啊！

scripts.text: Are your boots a problem now?
scripts.translation: 这时候还惦记你的靴子？

scripts.text: ... That's right, Maram. I have a favor to ask. Can you find someone who is missing a left leg but has a healthy right leg? I guess I'll have to sell him my right boot.
scripts.translation: ......是啊，玛拉姆，我想拜托你一件事。能不能找个左腿不方便、右腿还健全的人？我把右靴卖给他好了。先

scripts.text: Sir, please make this as smooth as possible.
scripts.translation: 生，麻烦你尽量处理得顺利些。

scripts.text: I'm not going to cutting your leg off, I can heal it.
scripts.translation: 我不会砍你的腿，我能治好它。

scripts.text: What? With a leg that is shaped like that?
scripts.translation: 什么？那条腿都变成那样了？

scripts.text: How do you fix a leg like that...! Let's cut it off and put some medicine on it to stop it from getting infected! Don't waste time by holding it...!
scripts.translation: 那种腿怎么治得好......！赶紧砍掉，再上药防止感染！别抱着它浪费时间了......！

scripts.text: I'm saying I can do it because I can do it. Everybody, get out of the way.
scripts.translation: 我说能治就能治。大家让开。

scripts.text: You'll have to trust him. Ezekiel may not look like much in your eyes, but he's pretty good, right?
scripts.translation: 你得相信他。以西结看起来也许不怎么样，但本事很不错，对吧？

scripts.text: Ahhh... If only we had the right equipment... I could have done it faster... I can't help it.
scripts.translation: 啊......要是有合适的器材，我就能更快治好......没办法了。

scripts.text: Adventurer, how's it going, can I start my construction?
scripts.translation: 冒险者，情况怎么样？我能开始建造了吗？

scripts.text: I'm trying to keep it out of the way so it doesn't affect anything else, but I guess that doesn't work either.
scripts.translation: 我试着把工程安排在不妨碍其他人的地方，可看来还是不行。

scripts.text: But I can't give up, and I'm glad you're willing to come back and talk about it, but before then, I need to get a group of like-minded people together and get ready to convince them.
scripts.translation: 但我不能放弃。很高兴你愿意回来谈这件事，不过在那之前，我得先召集一些志同道合的人，准备好说服大家。

scripts.text: I thought about doing what they said, but I can't. I don't know what else to do, but this is something I need to do.
scripts.translation: 我想过照他们说的做，可我办不到。我也不知道还能怎么办，但这件事我必须做。

scripts.text: Speaking of which, Adventurer, I have a favor to ask.
scripts.translation: 对了，冒险者，我有件事想请你帮忙。

scripts.text: You can get most things here, but not Steel. Because of how difficult it is to bring it in, not to mention you need a lot of facilities to make Steel. So, Would it be okay if you bring me 3 of them? just 3...
scripts.translation: 这里大部分东西都买得到，唯独没有钢材。运输钢材很困难，制造它又需要很多设备。能帮我带三块来吗？只要三块......

scripts.text: Thank you for your generosity. I'm glad you're so sympathetic to my cause and willing to help... I'll go get ready for construction.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你愿意帮忙。我很感激你理解我的想法......我先去准备建造的事。

scripts.text: Please convince <NAVI>[sir]<INFO>wolfvill,176,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>that we need this facility.
scripts.translation: 请说服<NAVI>[那位先生]<INFO>wolfvill,176,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，让他明白我们需要这项设施。

scripts.text: Ezekiel, you didn't come here to live a life of riches. You came here to do a job!
scripts.translation: 以西结，你来这里不是为了过富裕的生活，而是来完成工作的！

scripts.text: No, but to live here as myself is to really live. I am an eternal stranger here, am I not?
scripts.translation: 不，在这里做自己才算真正活着。可我永远是这里的外人，不是吗？

scripts.text: Shhh- wait a minute, listen to what he's saying, he sounds like he's saying something.
scripts.translation: 嘘，等一下，听听他说什么。他好像有话要说。

scripts.text: No, but I'm just as much an outsider here as I am there. Isn't that the same? Shouldn't I be more comfortable?
scripts.translation: 不，我在这里和在那边一样，都是个局外人。这不都一样吗？我不是应该过得自在些

scripts.text: Maybe I should just give up and go home.
scripts.translation: 吗？也许我该放弃，回家算了。

scripts.text: No, but that's what I initially aimed for. Finding my roots...
scripts.translation: 不，可这正是我最初想做的事......寻找自己的根......

scripts.text: Ezekiel! How have you been? Why are you muttering to yourself like that?
scripts.translation: 以西结！最近怎么样？你怎么一个人在这儿自言自语？

scripts.text: Maram? Maram?? That's great. You know what, listen to me. You're busy? You're busy, but listen. Who am I going to tell this to? I don't even know anybody yet. So listen to me.
scripts.translation: 玛拉姆？玛拉姆？太好了！听我说。你很忙？我知道你忙，可还是听我说吧。我还能跟谁说呢？我还不认识什么人。先听我说......

scripts.text: I told you I was going to build a clinic here. When I came here, there was no decent clinic, so I build one.
scripts.translation: 我说过要在这里建一所诊所。我刚来时，这里连像样的诊所都没有，所以我就打算建一所。

scripts.text: That's right. That's why I got a lot of things to fill it with this time.
scripts.translation: 是啊，所以这次我带了很多东西来添置设备。

scripts.text: I did that, but as soon as I started digging, the elders here stopped me. They say we should live in harmony with nature as we have done up until now, but they look at me as some sort of environmental destroyer. Am I that kind of person?
scripts.translation: 可我刚开始挖，长老们就来阻止。他们说应该像过去那样与自然和谐共处，却把我当成破坏环境的人。我真是那种人吗？

scripts.text: Is it really that destructive to nature and the environment to just build a more hygienic, more modern clinic, which would allow for a faster response in an emergency?
scripts.translation: 只为了建一座更卫生、更现代、能在紧急情况下及时救治病人的诊所，就会对自然和环境造成那么大破坏吗？

scripts.text: No. You aren't that kind of person. Everyone else, but never you.
scripts.translation: 不会。你不是那种人。别人或许是，但你绝不是。

scripts.text: Isn't that right? And you've gotten me to the point where... I'm not doing anything right now because I'm thinking, Am I really a bad person?
scripts.translation: 对吧？可现在我却开始怀疑自己是不是坏人，什么也做不了......

scripts.text: If that's the case, you should talk to Suad. That's not fair. We're all trying to live together. The clinic isn't against nature. Oh, come on.
scripts.translation: 既然这样，就该去找苏阿德谈谈。这不公平，大家都在努力一起生活。诊所并不违背自然。唉......

scripts.text: Well... I talked to Suad... but he said there was nothing he could do and that he couldn't do what he wanted either.
scripts.translation: 我和苏阿德谈过了......他说他无能为力，也不能随心所欲地做事。

scripts.text: I told him that we need a clinic, but we can't just push it through because the elderly people who have lived here for a long time are against it, so we have to convince them.
scripts.translation: 我告诉他我们需要诊所，可不能强行推进，因为在这里生活多年的长者们反对，所以得先说服他们。

scripts.text: From the sounds of it, so does he. We can't ignore the opinions of the elders, after all, and it's not like Suad's the kind of guy who'd bend over backwards to do so.
scripts.translation: 听起来他也这么想。毕竟不能无视长者们的意见，苏阿德也不是会强行做这件事的人。

scripts.text: So... I'm... going back to Rachel... What do you think?
scripts.translation: 所以......我......准备回拉赫了......你觉得呢？

scripts.text: What, you came this far and you're going back?
scripts.translation: 什么？都走到这一步了，你还要回去？

scripts.text: No, I didn't set out to go back... It's just that people are like that, they come here to have a better life, and if it's the same here or there, why wouldn't they want to stay where it's easier...
scripts.translation: 我不是特意想回去......只是人们来这里是为了过上更好的生活。如果这里和拉赫没什么两样，为什么不留在生活更轻松的地方呢......

scripts.text: So what I'm saying is... I'm trying to figure it out. When did I say I would just cut it and go back? Can you please not listen to me however you want?
scripts.translation: 我的意思是......我还在想办法。我什么时候说过要放弃回去？能不能别自作主张地理解我的话？

scripts.text: Hmmm... but the clinic is a necessity as far as I'm concerned, and if I can make the case...
scripts.translation: 嗯......可在我看来，诊所确实是必需的。如果能说服大家......

scripts.text: That's right! I think the adventurer might be able to help us out. You know, this adventurer is really good at talking, don't you think his face makes him believable? This is just the kind of prize that grown-ups like.
scripts.translation: 对了！冒险者也许能帮我们。你看，他很会说话，而且看起来就很可信，不是长辈们喜欢的那种人选吗？

scripts.text: He has a big heart, and he helped us buy and transport supplies.
scripts.translation: 他心地善良，还帮我们采购和运送物资。

scripts.text: He's a nice guy. He's a good man, yes, but...
scripts.translation: 他是个好人，确实很好......可是......

scripts.text: ...Is that really the kind of person who gets the favor of the adults? They're so... so... stubborn.
scripts.translation: ......这样的人真能得到长辈们的支持吗？他们实在......太固执了。

scripts.text: You have to make the most of it. Even if I can't persuade you, what else is there to do but listen to more nagging? Is that the adventurer going to listen to that instead?
scripts.translation: 你得把握机会。就算我说不动他们，难道你要让冒险者去听那些唠叨吗？

scripts.text: Well... Can I ask you a favor?
Adventurer, do me a favor, we really need a modern clinic here, even if it's not as big as the one from Rachel.
scripts.translation: 你一件事吗？冒险者，我们真的需要一间现代化诊所，就算没有拉赫那间那么大也行。

scripts.text: Where I am now, if I get hurt or sick, I have to rely on folk remedies from the past.
scripts.translation: 我现在住的地方，受伤或生病时只能靠过去的民间疗法。

scripts.text: I have some medicines and medical supplies from Rachel, but they are scarce, and I'm not in the right place to use them.
scripts.translation: 我从拉赫带来了一些药品和医疗用品，但数量有限，而且这里也不适合使用。

scripts.text: But there's nothing I can do to convince the naysayers, so I'm going to ask an adventurer <NAVI>[sir]<INFO>wolfvill,176,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> to do it for me.
scripts.translation: 我实在说服不了反对的人，所以想请冒险者<NAVI>[先生]<INFO>wolfvill,176,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>替我去说服他们。

scripts.text: Please do, and in the meantime, I'll go meet some other people.
scripts.translation: 拜托你了。我趁这段时间去见见其他人。

scripts.text: How about this? Don't push yourself for a while, eat good food, think good thoughts, and rest well, and you'll be able to walk or run lightly.
scripts.translation: 这样吧，暂时别勉强自己，多吃点好东西、想些开心的事，好好休息，就能轻松走路甚至跑起来。

scripts.text: Am I alive?? Am I alive?? Is my leg okay??
scripts.translation: 我还活着吗？？还活着吗？？我的腿没事吧？？

scripts.text: Uh, since you say it is, it must be, right?
scripts.translation: 呃，你说没事，那应该就是没事吧？

scripts.text: Thank you so much!! You saved my boots! What's your name? I'll be good to you in the future. You're my savior. I never forget his saviors. For life.
scripts.translation: 太感谢了！！你保住了我的靴子！你叫什么名字？以后我一定会好好报答你。你是我的救命恩人，我一辈子都不会忘记！

scripts.text: So, how did you save the leg?
scripts.translation: 那么，你是怎么保住他的腿的？

scripts.text: Because that's what I learned. If the clinic had been properly equipped, we could have treated him more completely and accelerated his recovery.
scripts.translation: 这是我学过的医术。要是诊所设备齐全，我们就能治得更彻底，也能让他恢复得更快。

scripts.text: Hmm... Is that what everyone does these days?
scripts.translation: 嗯......现在都是这么治的吗？

scripts.text: Yeah, it's not going to cost you your leg, as long as you treat it right.
scripts.translation: 是啊，只要处理得当，他的腿就能保住。

scripts.text: You can do that faster and more appropriately if you have a clinic, right?
scripts.translation: 有了诊所，就能更快、更妥善地治疗，对吧？

scripts.text: Hmm... That's the way it is these days, isn't it, Adventurer?
scripts.translation: 嗯......现在的医疗就是这样，对吧，冒险者？

scripts.text: That's the way it is these days.
Like I said, it's not the technology of the foreigns, it's the technology and facilities of the advanced era.
scripts.translation: 正如我说的，这不是外来技术，而是新时代的技术和设施。

scripts.text: Hmm, I don't think this is something you should just blindly oppose.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我觉得这事不该一味反对。

scripts.text: Right? That's my opinion too. It's about saving people. If we do it our way, we can save something from death.
scripts.translation: 对吧？我也这么想。关键是救人。用这种方法，至少能把一些人从死亡边缘救回来。

scripts.text: Hmm... How long would it take to build that clinic?
scripts.translation: 嗯......建好那座诊所需要多久？

scripts.text: Eh...? Well, it depends on labor and capital.
We'll help you as much as we can. Let's build it.
scripts.translation: 我们会尽量帮忙。就建起来吧。

scripts.text: Instead, it should fit in with the way of life here, it should fit in with the place.
scripts.translation: 不过，诊所得符合这里的生活方式，也要和这片地方相称。

scripts.text: Wow, you guys thought of everything. This is exactly what I need, and I'm all for it.
scripts.translation: 哇，你们考虑得真周到。这正合我意，我完全赞成。

scripts.text: Is there anything else we need here?
scripts.translation: 这里还有什么需要的吗？

scripts.text: What, you're accepting more than clinics?
scripts.translation: 怎么，除了诊所，你们还想要别的？

scripts.text: Didn't that make you think? You have to go with the flow. You can't be stubborn forever.
scripts.translation: 这还不够说明问题吗？得顺应变化，不能一直固执下去。

scripts.text: I mean, we're not going to live the way we do now, even if we do reclaim our land. We already live differently than we used to.
scripts.translation: 我的意思是，就算我们夺回土地，也不会再过以前那样的生活了。我们的生活早就变了。

scripts.text: Hey, young man, if there's anything else that's important or necessary, let me know and we'll give it some thought.
scripts.translation: 年轻人，要是还有什么重要或必要的东西，就告诉我们，我们会考虑。

scripts.text: I will. I'll build the clinic as close to this place as possible, as you said.
scripts.translation: 我会的。我会照你说的，尽量让诊所融入这里。

scripts.text: Yeah. You know we're not going to live here forever, right?
scripts.translation: 是啊。你知道我们不会永远住在这里吧？

scripts.text: Yes, that's exactly what I thought.
Well, we'll take our leave. Thank you for your time today.
scripts.translation: 那我们先告辞了。谢谢你今天抽空。

scripts.text: Whoa- that's a relief, isn't it?
Yeah, it's there... right? But it's so abrupt that it's a little baffling, isn't it?
scripts.translation: 嗯，真的有了......对吧？不过事情变化得太突然，我还有点反应不过来。

scripts.text: Now that they've seen it with their own eyes, they think differently. That's good. Now, let's finish what we started, shall we?
scripts.translation: 他们亲眼看到了，想法自然就变了。这很好。现在继续把事情做完吧？

scripts.text: Yes. But first, I think we need to change the design to match this place.
scripts.translation: 好。不过首先得调整设计，让它更适合这里。

scripts.text: The Adventurer will help you, right?
If you need any equipment or tools, let me know in advance and I'll bring them next time.
scripts.translation: 需要设备或工具的话提前告诉我，我下次带来。乔尔，我

scripts.text: Joel, let's go get some rest, too.
Goodbye, my savior. I'll be back in the near future!
scripts.translation: 再见了，我的救命恩人！我很快会回来的！

scripts.text: Adventurer, thank you so much for your help. This is what I got when I got settled here, and I don't need anything... I'll give it to you, Adventurer, as a token of my appreciation.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，非常感谢你帮忙。这是我刚在这里安顿下来时得到的东西，我用不上，就送给你表示谢意吧。

scripts.text: Well, until next time, and maybe I'll ask you for a favor, so stop by often!
scripts.translation: 那就下次见。以后说不定还要麻烦你，记得常来！

scripts.translation: 唉，真不容易。冒险者，你看这里，之前带来的东西正在施工......现在进来很危险，天亮后再来吧。

scripts.text: It's fine. But we're still short on some things, like Steel and Very Unusual Crystals.
scripts.translation: 还不错，不过还缺一些材料，比如钢材和特异结晶。

scripts.text: They use a lot of crystals here, and they're very hard, so they're great to use here and there.
scripts.translation: 这里会用到很多结晶。它们非常坚硬，用在各处都很合适。

Are you busy? It seemed like that. Even if you are busy, make sure to eat your meals.

scripts.text: Thank you, Adventurer, for your efforts. Uh... but we're a little low on quantity, did you forget...?
scripts.translation: 冒险者，辛苦你了，谢谢......不过数量还差一点，你是不是忘了？

scripts.translation: 我需要1个钢铁和10个特异结晶，特异结晶可以从灰狼身上取得。

scripts.text: Adventurer, you've worked hard. I'm always grateful. I'll take a break today and see you again after dawn!
scripts.translation: 冒险者，辛苦了。一直以来都很感谢你。今天我先休息，天亮后再见！

If you have any difficulties in life, tell me.
scripts.translation: 生活上有什么困难就告诉我。

scripts.text: I've got to see the newcomers.
scripts.translation: 我得去看看那些新来的人。

scripts.text: The people who came in this time will also have to adapt well.
scripts.translation: 这次来的人也得好好适应这里。

scripts.text: We'll have to take another look.
